what: A Hero where a solid color plate covers the screen with a logo-shaped hole punched through it, showing what lies beyond (the 3D scene or video). On open, the hole changes from a center point to the logo shape over .9s (cubic in-out), and near the end the plate swells once on an e^12 tempo and spreads. As the section scrolls, the plate comes toward the camera (1/(1−p) times), so the hole passes beyond the screen and barrel distortion (−p·6) bends the edges. Where the mouse has passed (radius .095, 600ms), the plate pattern is pushed aside by grain noise (before scroll (1−p)^4·.6).

options.reveal: load (opens right on attach, default) · manual (when the fx:reveal event arrives at the element — after the loader, or with detail.instant it is already open immediately). Once fully open, fx:revealed fires.
options.barrel: Barrel distortion strength at scroll end, default 6 (touch screen barrelMobile 1.5)
options.scale: Panel uv scale, default 1.4 — larger means smaller holes
options.pulse: Swell strength near the end, default .2
options.radius: Mark radius (share of board width), default .095

use: <section data-fx="shape-hole-hero" style="height:100svh; --fx-hole: var(--kf-contrast-bg)"></section> — what lies beyond the hole is a screen-fixed scene laid behind this section. three.cjs goes between scroll-sag-warp/three-pre.js·three-post.js
note: The original loads the logo-shaped SDF as a KTX2 image (green channel) and draws the mouse trail with drei’s fluid trail plane (1024, difference blending). Here the same formula was rewritten with our own SDF made of five circles blended smoothly and a 256 plane 2d trail. To change the hole shape, edit shape() in fx.js.

from.where: index.html Hero (original PodiumShapeMaterial — shapeReveal .9s cubic in-out, pulse e^12 · .2, uvScale 1.4, barrel 6, fluid .6, noise .6)
